title: EMRB: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Reasoning over Raw Electromagnetic Signals
abstract: arXiv:2608.24086v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as code agents for scientific and engineering analysis, but their ability to analyze raw physical-layer measurements remains untested. We introduce \textbf{EMRB} (\textbf{E}lectro\textbf{m}agnetic \textbf{R}easoning \textbf{B}enchmark), which evaluates whether LLMs can analyze raw I/Q data by writing and running code. EMRB contains 200 problems across five difficulty levels and 27 question types, from signal detection to OFDM design, generated from 11 signal types with verified ground truth. Unlike benchmarks built on preprocessed features or structured tables, EMRB provides only the raw capture; the quantities each question refers to must first be discovered through code. We evaluate 14 LLMs spanning proprietary, open-weight, and reasoning-oriented families. translated_title: EMRB：一个用于评估大语言模型对原始电磁信号推理能力的多层级基准
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用作科学和工程分析的代码代理，但它们分析原始物理层测量的能力仍未得到测试。我们引入了**EMRB**（**电**磁**推理**基准），该基准评估LLMs是否能够通过编写和执行代码来分析原始I/Q数据。EMRB包含200个问题，涵盖五个难度级别和27种问题类型，从信号检测到OFDM设计，这些数据由11种信号类型生成，并具有验证过的地面真值。与基于预处理特征或结构化表格的基准不同，EMRB仅提供原始捕获数据；每个问题所涉及的量必须首先通过代码发现。我们评估了14个LLMs，涵盖专有、开放权重和推理导向的模型系列。得分范围从24.1%到78.9%，平均值从基本测量的84.9%下降到系统设计的21.2%。我们还提供了初步分析，以突出关键失败模式。
tldr: EMRB基准首次系统评估了大语言模型通过代码分析原始电磁信号的能力，揭示了从基础测量到系统设计的性能显著下降，并指出了关键失败模式。
en_tdlr: The EMRB benchmark is the first to systematically evaluate LLMs' ability to analyze raw electromagnetic signals via code, revealing a significant performance drop from basic measurement to system design and highlighting key failure modes.
